root_cause.text: In xfs_attr3_leaf_add_work, when growing the leaf entry array, the freemap adjustment code only updated the freemap entry whose base exactly matched the old end of the array, failing to shift other freemap entries that overlapped with the expanded array, causing a corrupted freemap where free space is claimed inside the entries array.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explains that after adding two xattrs, freemap[1] (base=388) was not updated while freemap[0] was shifted from base=376 to base=392, leading to overlap: "This is bad, because freemap[1] hasn't been updated, and now the entries array and the free space claim the same space." The patch adds a second condition `else if (ichdr->freemap[i].size > 0 && ichdr->freemap[i].base < new_end)` to adjust those overlapped entries.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add local variables old_end and new_end to prepare for tracking attribute leaf entry boundaries.
intent_record.what: Added two local integer variables 'old_end' and 'new_end' to the function xfs_attr3_leaf_add_work.
intent_record.how: No behavioral change; the variables are declared but not yet used.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix freemap corruption when adding a leaf entry by adjusting any freemap entry that starts in the newly allocated space, not just the entry at the exact old end.
intent_record.what: Replaced single-case freemap adjustment (only for exact match to old end) with a two-case adjustment: if freemap base equals old_end, diff = sizeof(entry); else if freemap base < new_end and size > 0, diff = new_end - base. Also updated ASSERT and variable names.
intent_record.how: Ensures all freemap entries whose base falls within the space newly occupied by the leaf entry are shifted upward and shrunk accordingly, preventing incorrect free space tracking.

candidates.rationale: This condition only updates a freemap entry whose base exactly matches the old end of the entries array ('tmp'). It fails to adjust any freemap entry that starts within the newly allocated space (i.e., between old_end and old_end + sizeof(entry)), causing the freemap to claim free space that overlaps with the expanded entry array, resulting in corruption.
